svg.title: Растяжка ягодиц сидя — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. ONE figure only. Seated figure-four glute stretch on flat stable chair. One foot flat on floor, opposite ankle rests across supporting thigh immediately above knee, crossed knee opens outward. Adult leans forward slightly from hips with neutral back, hands lightly steady the crossed leg. Three-quarter front angle makes ankle crossing and chair clear. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
